rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 38: the prototype's single 'Embryos/Ova' items are mock data and are not copied, so its Cat and Dog Embryos/Ova entries carry no weight; with claims 25 and 26 (each set's catalogue holds only its own commodities, and the 12 germinal lines now in the live-animals catalogue move out), and sources.json precedence ranking confluence:6497338582 (V4, the germinal set's data policy, including where each field applies) above prototype:dr2-1-source, which decides look and feel only, never which data a notification captures.
outcome: The germinal products catalogue holds V4's 12 germinal commodities only, with embryos and ova split (ruling 9 October) and V4's 'Semen - Dog or Cat' shown as Design Release 2.1's separate Cat, Semen and Dog, Semen: Cattle, Goat, Horse, Pig and Sheep embryos and ova, and Cat, Cattle, Dog, Goat, Horse, Pig, Rabbit/Rodent and Sheep semen, 18 items. Cat and Dog embryos and ova are not offered: they come only from the prototype's Embryos/Ova mock data, which the 9 October ruling says is not copied, and V4, which outranks the prototype on what data the germinal set captures and where it applies, gives them no fields. Every V4 germinal field (temperature and the four Unit Level identifiers) therefore applies to every item in the catalogue.
